name: ai-security-sdlc
description: Agent plugins for securing an AI-first SDLC: secure agent setup and starter templates, secure-by-design planning, AI evals, red teaming, pentest, SAST and remediation.

plugins.name: ai-security-build-guidance
plugins.description: Plan/Code phase: secure setup of your AI coding/agent tools (permissions, sandboxing, egress, MCP trust) and architecture-aware secure-by-design starter templates you build on, then harden with secure-plan.

plugins.name: secure-sdlc
plugins.description: Entry point for the ai-security-sdlc toolkit: SDLC orientation and secure agent setup with starter templates and opt-in hooks (security-guidance), the shared app security profile, an index-routed security-standards knowledge corpus, intent-to-spec-to-plan security planning with CodeGuard-backed Secure Build Plans, and remediation that closes findings back into standards and plans.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verify the code you ship: a six-lane blind scanner ensemble (semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, OSV-Scanner, zizmor + model-driven review) triaged into one ranked SARIF, CodeQL CI setup and read-back, and autonomous Strix DAST pentesting — results into .ai-security/results for remediation.

plugins.name: verify-ai
plugins.description: Verify the AI layer: Promptfoo baseline evals and curated cyber benchmarks (b3, CyberSecEval 4, JailbreakBench), multi-turn adversarial red teaming configured from the security profile, and supply-chain scans of packaged AI assets (models, MCP servers, skills) — findings into .ai-security/results for remediation.
